page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top; page number at top right; catchword/signature block at foot ("C 5" and "CAP." at the lower right area); a woodcut ornament in the centre; a strip of show-through text at the left edge (not transcribed).

main_text.p: & possint eum, salvâ ipsorum conscien- tiâ, in hâc confessione persistentem admittere, & pro vero Ecclesiæ membro agnoscere, atque hinc ipsius postula- tioni, illi assentiantur. Quæ hypothe- sis quia ab hujusmodi hominibus non vult admitti, de quibus diximus, non potest quis apud eos, meo judicio, salvâ conscientiâ uti Eucharistiâ. Vide alias circumstantias apud Vrsinum plu- ribus explica- tas.
The ornament in the centre of the page is a woodcut device, not text.

page.notes: Show-through text along the left edge and faint marginal fragments are not transcribed. The running head and page number are read from the top of the page. The word "CAP." and "C 5" at the foot are taken as catchword and signature, which is uncertain. Words such as "Vrsinum" are copied as printed.
